title: Students Performing in School Play Outdoors, 1974 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot taken in October 1974 showing an outdoor school play or historical presentation on a schoolyard lawn. In the foreground, a smiling young girl in a dark double-breasted jacket stands beside a boy dressed in a cape and colonial-style tricorn hat. Behind them, a crowd of classmates and teachers observes the performance against the exterior corridor of a mid-century school building.
